correctness.rationale: An idempotent nondecreasing unit-step map fixes its contiguous image and hence is a unique clamp; direct clipping proves the exact commuting criterion for overlapping/disjoint intervals. Pairwise Helly and singleton clamps give the maximal star subbands. Endpoint maxima/minima are counted by first differences of powers, giving the rank profile without double counting, and two Eulerian series convolutions yield the rational generating functions. Polynomial-pole asymptotics and a uniform convolution bound prove the fixed-m density and probability limit. The standalone standard-library checker independently enumerates 102917 candidate tuples in 30 configurations and confirms every rank coefficient, including boundaries; finite checks are not the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The maximal commuting subband classification gives all maximal semilattices inside a naturally studied noncommutative idempotent band, and the exact joint tuple-length/rank distribution resolves an intrinsic multiplicative invariant. The fixed-arity Beta limit gives a quantitative probabilistic law for typical common products; neither the earlier individual-idempotent counts nor a coincident OEIS pair-total row supplies this structural or all-arity information. The result is an exact natural finite-semigroup classification without relying on unsupported downstream claims.
